hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Answers to common questions about MT5, hosting, liquidity, CRM and more.

items.q: Can you help us launch a brokerage from scratch?
items.a: Yes. Our brokerage setup service covers platform selection, hosting, liquidity connectivity, CRM and KYC integration, testing and go-live. Licensing and regulatory approval remain your responsibility.

items.q: Do you only work with MT5?
items.a: MT5 is our main focus for new deployments, but we also maintain MT4 environments and help brokers plan migrations from MT4 to MT5.

items.q: What's the difference between a bridge, a gateway and a FIX connection?
items.a: All three connect your trading platform to liquidity. They differ in how orders are routed, how much control you have and how they're maintained. We'll walk you through the options during discovery.

items.q: Can you take over support of an existing MT5 setup?
items.a: Yes. We start with a technical review of your current configuration, hosting and integrations, then agree on a maintenance plan covering monitoring, upgrades and incident response.

items.q: Do you handle KYC and AML compliance for us?
items.a: We handle the technical integration: connecting verification providers, building the approval workflow and syncing results to your CRM. Your compliance obligations stay with your regulated business.

items.q: Can we choose only the services we need?
items.a: Absolutely. Our forex brokerage technology is modular. Some clients come only for hosting or liquidity connectivity; others want the full stack.
